findings.Note: Vague pseudo-profound phrasing that doesn't clarify what the water is or does; reads as filler abstraction.
findings.Fix: Ground it in a concrete sensory detail instead of a tautological description.

findings.Quote: It looked the way it had looked before any of this was built. It didn't know about the drills.
findings.Note: Nature-as-indifferent-ancient-witness is a familiar device, verging on stock sentiment.
findings.Fix: Trim to one plain observation or specify a concrete detail that carries the point.

findings.Quote: The door on that question was shut, and it carried no inspection stamp.
findings.Note: The bureaucratic-inspection-stamp metaphor is a strained extension of the door image, unclear on literal terms.
findings.Fix: Drop the inspection-stamp clause or replace with a clearer image.

findings.Quote: Not dropped, not thrown — set down with care, the way you set down something that belongs to someone else.
findings.Note: Simile explains itself redundantly after already stating the care directly; slightly padded construction.
findings.Fix: Cut to: 'Not dropped, not thrown — set down with care.'

findings.Quote: The lake sat past the seawall, indifferent to all of it.
findings.Note: Pathetic-fallacy-by-negation is a familiar move (nature's indifference as commentary) and adds little concrete image.
findings.Fix: Ground it in a specific sensory detail instead of stating indifference abstractly.

findings.Quote: asking nothing, expecting nothing, still here
findings.Note: Triplet personification of the frequency is reaching for portentous rhythm without new information beyond 'patient and unresigned' just prior.
findings.Fix: Trim to one clause, e.g. 'asking nothing, still here.'

findings.Quote: the dark throat of the vacuum line open in front of her
findings.Note: Sets up a metaphor repeated almost verbatim in the next beat, making it read as a stock image rather than a fresh one.
findings.Fix: Vary the image here or in beat 3 so it doesn't duplicate.

findings.Quote: she'd learned early to look a new thing over before she trusted it
findings.Note: Generic aphoristic tell-not-show of her wariness, rather than dramatized caution.
findings.Fix: Cut the explanatory clause; let the noticing speak for itself.

findings.Quote: A thing to keep, the way she kept everything: private, hers, deniable.
findings.Note: Reads as a summarizing character-trait statement rather than scene-specific detail; borders on telling.
findings.Fix: Ground it in a concrete instance instead of a general claim about 'everything.'

findings.Quote: the densest signal field on the continent
findings.Note: Generic superlative worldbuilding phrase, stock-feeling scale statement.
findings.Fix: Replace with a more specific, textured detail about the field.

findings.Quote: Not first. Last.
findings.Note: Staccato fragment repetition reads as a stylistic tic rather than earned emphasis; it tells us the significance instead of letting the preceding action carry it.
findings.Fix: Cut the fragment pair or fold into the prior sentence: 'she stepped through last, not first.'
